mapper.select: select from token_access_tokens where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and token_id=#{tokenId}
select from token_access_tokens where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and token_prefix=#{prefix}
select tenant_id as "tenantId" from iam_personal_access_token_directory where token_prefix=#{prefix} and token_type='PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN' and status in ('ACTIVE','ROTATING') and expires_at>now()

select from token_access_tokens where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and principal_type=#{principalType} and principal_id=#{principalId} and token_type=#{tokenType} and status='ACTIVE' and expires_at>now() order by issued_at desc

select count(*) from token_access_tokens where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and principal_type=#{principalType} and principal_id=#{principalId} and token_type=#{tokenType} and status='ACTIVE' and expires_at>now()
mapper.update: update token_access_tokens set last_used_at=#{row.lastUsedAt},rotation_grace_expires_at=#{row.rotationGraceExpiresAt},revoked_at=#{row.revokedAt},revoked_by=#{row.revokedBy},revocation_reason=#{row.revocationReason},consumed_at=#{row.consumedAt},status=#{row.status},use_count=#{row.useCount},version=#{row.version} where tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} and token_id=#{row.tokenId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.sql: tenant_id as "tenantId",service_account_id as "serviceAccountId",account_name as "accountName",description,owner_user_id as "ownerUserId",owner_department_id as "ownerDepartmentId",responsibility_binding_id as "responsibilityBindingId",array_to_string(permission_scopes,chr(31)) as "permissionsCsv",array_to_string(allowed_audiences,chr(31)) as "audiencesCsv",array_to_string(allowed_api_prefixes,chr(31)) as "apiPrefixesCsv",array_to_string(allowed_cidrs,chr(31)) as "cidrsCsv",array_to_string(machine_scopes,chr(31)) as "machineScopesCsv",array_to_string(allowed_source_systems,chr(31)) as "sourceSystemsCsv",token_max_ttl_seconds as "tokenMaxTtlSeconds",max_active_tokens as "maxActiveTokens",credential_max_ttl_seconds as "credentialMaxTtlSeconds",max_active_credentials as "maxActiveCredentials",rate_limit_per_minute as "rateLimitPerMinute",last_reviewed_at as "lastReviewedAt",next_review_at as "nextReviewAt",risk_level as "riskLevel",status,status_reason as "statusReason",created_at as "createdAt",updated_at as "updatedAt",created_by as "createdBy",updated_by as "updatedBy",version
mapper.select: select from token_service_accounts where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and service_account_id=#{serviceAccountId}
mapper.update: update token_service_accounts set owner_user_id=#{row.ownerUserId},owner_department_id=#{row.ownerDepartmentId},responsibility_binding_id=#{row.responsibilityBindingId},permission_scopes=string_to_array(#{row.permissionsCsv},chr(31)),allowed_audiences=string_to_array(#{row.audiencesCsv},chr(31)),allowed_api_prefixes=string_to_array(#{row.apiPrefixesCsv},chr(31)),allowed_cidrs=string_to_array(#{row.cidrsCsv},chr(31)),machine_scopes=string_to_array(#{row.machineScopesCsv},chr(31)),allowed_source_systems=string_to_array(#{row.sourceSystemsCsv},chr(31)),credential_max_ttl_seconds=#{row.credentialMaxTtlSeconds},max_active_credentials=#{row.maxActiveCredentials},last_reviewed_at=#{row.lastReviewedAt},next_review_at=#{row.nextReviewAt},risk_level=#{row.riskLevel},status=#{row.status},status_reason=#{row.statusReason},updated_at=#{row.updatedAt},updated_by=#{row.updatedBy},version=#{row.version} where tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} and service_account_id=#{row.serviceAccountId} and version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.sql: tenant_id as "tenantId",credential_id as "credentialId",service_account_id as "serviceAccountId",credential_type as "credentialType",credential_name as "credentialName",client_id as "clientId",last4,hash_algorithm as "hashAlgorithm",secret_hash as "secretHash",issued_at as "issuedAt",expires_at as "expiresAt",last_used_at as "lastUsedAt",rotated_from_credential_id as "rotatedFromCredentialId",rotation_grace_expires_at as "rotationGraceExpiresAt",revoked_at as "revokedAt",revoked_by as "revokedBy",revocation_reason as "revocationReason",status,use_count as "useCount",created_at as "createdAt",updated_at as "updatedAt",created_by as "createdBy",updated_by as "updatedBy",version
mapper.select: select from token_service_account_credentials where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and credential_id=#{credentialId}
select from token_service_account_credentials where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and client_id=#{clientId}

select count(*) from token_service_account_credentials where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and service_account_id=#{serviceAccountId} and status in('ACTIVE','ROTATING') and expires_at>now() and (status='ACTIVE' or rotation_grace_expires_at>now())
mapper.update: update token_service_account_credentials set last_used_at=#{row.lastUsedAt},rotation_grace_expires_at=#{row.rotationGraceExpiresAt},revoked_at=#{row.revokedAt},revoked_by=#{row.revokedBy},revocation_reason=#{row.revocationReason},status=#{row.status},use_count=#{row.useCount},updated_at=#{row.updatedAt},updated_by=#{row.updatedBy},version=#{row.version} where tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} and credential_id=#{row.credentialId} and version=#{expectedVersion}

update token_service_account_credentials set last_used_at=#{usedAt},use_count=use_count+1,updated_at=#{usedAt},version=version+1 where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and credential_id=#{credentialId} and expires_at>#{usedAt} and (status='ACTIVE' or (status='ROTATING' and rotation_grace_expires_at>#{usedAt}))
mapper.select: select personal_default_ttl_seconds as "personalDefaultTtlSeconds",personal_max_ttl_seconds as "personalMaxTtlSeconds",service_default_ttl_seconds as "serviceDefaultTtlSeconds",service_max_ttl_seconds as "serviceMaxTtlSeconds",max_active_personal_tokens as "maxActivePersonalTokens",max_active_service_tokens as "maxActiveServiceTokens",require_service_cidr as "requireServiceCidr" from token_tenant_policies where tenant_id=#{tenantId}

with effective_principals(principal_type,principal_id) as (select #{principalType},#{principalId} union all select 'GROUP',gm.group_id from org_group_memberships gm where #{principalType}='USER' and gm.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and gm.user_id=#{principalId} and gm.status='ACTIVE' and gm.effective_at<=#{at} and (gm.expires_at is null or gm.expires_at>#{at})) select distinct rp.permission_point from effective_principals ep join rbac_principal_role_bindings b on b.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and b.principal_type=ep.principal_type and b.principal_id=ep.principal_id and b.status='ACTIVE' and b.effective_at<=#{at} and (b.expires_at is null or b.expires_at>#{at}) join rbac_roles r on r.role_id=b.role_id and r.status='ACTIVE' join rbac_role_permissions rp on rp.role_id=r.role_id

select case when #{principalType}='USER' then (select count(*) from iam_users u join tenants tenant on tenant.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and tenant.status='ACTIVE' join org_tenant_memberships m on m.user_id=u.user_id and m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and m.status='ACTIVE' where u.user_id=#{principalId} and u.status='ACTIVE') when #{principalType}='SERVICE_ACCOUNT' then (select count(*) from token_service_accounts sa join tenants tenant on tenant.tenant_id=sa.tenant_id and tenant.status='ACTIVE' join iam_users u on u.user_id=sa.owner_user_id and u.status='ACTIVE' join org_tenant_memberships tm on tm.tenant_id=sa.tenant_id and tm.user_id=sa.owner_user_id and tm.status='ACTIVE' join departments d on d.tenant_id=sa.tenant_id and d.department_id=sa.owner_department_id and d.status='ACTIVE' join org_department_memberships dm on dm.tenant_id=sa.tenant_id and dm.user_id=sa.owner_user_id and dm.department_id=sa.owner_department_id and dm.status='ACTIVE' and dm.effective_at<=now() and (dm.expires_at is null or dm.expires_at>now()) where sa.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and sa.service_account_id=#{principalId} and sa.status='ACTIVE' and sa.next_review_at>now()) else 0 end

select count(*) from iam_users u join tenants tenant on tenant.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and tenant.status='ACTIVE' join org_tenant_memberships m on m.user_id=u.user_id and m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and m.status in('INVITED','ACTIVE','SUSPENDED') where u.user_id=#{principalId} and ((#{tokenType}='INVITATION_TOKEN' and u.status in('PENDING_ACTIVATION','PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED','MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED')) or (#{tokenType}='PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN' and u.status in('ACTIVE','LOCKED','PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED','MFA_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED')) or (#{tokenType}='EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TOKEN' and u.status not in('DELETED','DISABLED')))

select count(*) from iam_users u join tenants tenant on tenant.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and tenant.status='ACTIVE' join org_tenant_memberships m on m.user_id=u.user_id and m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and m.status='ACTIVE' join departments d on d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and d.department_id=#{ownerDepartmentId} and d.status='ACTIVE' join org_department_memberships dm on dm.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and dm.user_id=u.user_id and dm.department_id=#{ownerDepartmentId} and dm.status='ACTIVE' and dm.effective_at<=now() and (dm.expires_at is null or dm.expires_at>now()) where u.user_id=#{ownerUserId} and u.status='ACTIVE'

with upsert as (insert into token_rate_limit_windows(tenant_id,rate_limit_key,window_start,request_count) values(#{tenantId},#{rateLimitKey},#{windowStart},1) on conflict(tenant_id,rate_limit_key,window_start) do update set request_count=token_rate_limit_windows.request_count+1 where token_rate_limit_windows.request_count<#{limit} returning request_count) select exists(select 1 from upsert)

select client_id as "clientId",tenant_id as "tenantId",credential_id as "credentialId",service_account_id as "serviceAccountId",credential_type as "credentialType",status,expires_at as "expiresAt" from iam_machine_credential_directory where client_id=#{clientId}

select from phase8c_activate_machine_signing_key(#{row.keyId},#{row.algorithm},#{row.publicKeyDerBase64},#{row.protectedPrivateKey},#{row.protectionKeyId},#{row.activatedAt},#{row.rotateAfter},#{at},#{previousVerifyUntil})

with cleanup as (delete from iam_machine_oauth_rate_limit_windows where window_start<#{cleanupBefore}), upsert as (insert into iam_machine_oauth_rate_limit_windows(rate_key,window_start,request_count) values(#{rateKey},#{windowStart},1) on conflict(rate_key,window_start) do update set request_count=iam_machine_oauth_rate_limit_windows.request_count+1 where iam_machine_oauth_rate_limit_windows.request_count<#{limit} returning request_count) select exists(select 1 from upsert)
mapper.insert: insert into iam_machine_token_issuance_events(event_id,outcome,reason_code,tenant_id,service_account_id,credential_id,client_id,jwt_id,scopes,audience,source_ip,correlation_id,occurred_at) values(#{row.eventId},#{row.outcome},#{row.reasonCode},#{row.tenantId},#{row.serviceAccountId},#{row.credentialId},#{row.clientId},#{row.jwtId},case when #{row.scopesCsv}='' then array[]::varchar[] else string_to_array(#{row.scopesCsv},chr(31)) end,#{row.audience},#{row.sourceIp},#{row.correlationId},#{row.occurredAt})
